packet	golden

sheet 1	s1-stock	Antibiotic stocks for Experiment golden
  ops	stock
  module	preparation_of_antibiotic_1000x_stock
  values	preparation_of_antibiotic_1000x_stock	{"antibiotic":"kan"}
  text	{preparation_of_antibiotic_1000x_stock}
  note	The inventory does not record a stock of kan. Check the shelf before you weigh anything — if there is one, write down where you found it and skip this session.
  note	Plates and media are made from this stock, so it comes before everything else.

sheet 2	s2-dilution	Oligo dilutions for Experiment golden
  ops	dilution
  dilution	100 -> 10 uM
  target	goR1	ask
  target	goF2	GoldBox B1
  target	goR2	ask
  note	The inventory does not record where goR1, goR2 live. That is a gap in the document, not proof they are missing — write down where you find them and the inventory is updated from this sheet when it comes back.
  note	STILL TO DECIDE: where the 2 unlocated oligo stock(s) are — the sheet asks, and the returned workbook is what updates the inventory

sheet 3	s3-pcr	PCR for Experiment golden
  ops	pcr
  module	primestar_pcr
  destination	the to-gel box
  values	primestar_pcr	{"per_sample":true,"reactions":2,"use_mastermix":false}
  source	goF1	GoldBox	A1				10 µM
  source	goR1			made			the 10 µM working stock you made in session 2
  source	pSRC1	GoldBox	D1				miniprep DNA
  source	goF2			made			the 10 µM working stock you made in session 2
  source	goR2			made			the 10 µM working stock you made in session 2
  source	pSRC2				ask		no tube of pSRC2 is in the inventory
  columns	label | construct | forward oligo | reverse oligo | template | expected size | program
  sample	Goa | frag1 | goF1 | goR1 | pSRC1 | 1374 bp | PG2K55
  sample	Gob | backbone | goF2 | goR2 | pSRC2 | 1676 bp | PG2K55
  recipe	32 uL	ddH2O (white)	
  recipe	10 uL	5X PrimeSTAR GXL Buffer (green)	
  recipe	4 uL	PrimeSTAR dNTP Mixture (2.5 mM each, yellow)	
  recipe	1 uL	10 uM primer 1 (white)	varies:forward_oligo
  recipe	1 uL	10 uM primer 2 (white)	varies:reverse_oligo
  recipe	1 uL	dil20x plasmid template (white)	varies:template
  recipe	1 uL	PrimeSTAR GXL DNA Polymerase	
  text	{primestar_pcr}

sheet 4	s4-gel-zymo-goldengate	Gel, cleanup and assembly for Experiment golden
  ops	gel,zymo,goldengate
  module	analytical_gel
  values	analytical_gel	{"samples":2}
  values	zymo_cleanup	{"reactions":2}
  values	golden_gate_assembly	{"enzyme":"BsaI","fragments":2,"reactions":1}
  source	frag1			made			made by the pcr step that produces frag1
  source	backbone			made			made by the pcr step that produces backbone
  columns	loads tube | construct | expected size
  sample	Goa | frag1 | 1374 bp
  sample	Gob | backbone | 1676 bp
  text	{analytical_gel}
  heading	Cleanup
  row	label | from | construct | size
  row	zGoa | Goa | frag1 | 1374 bp
  row	zGob | Gob | backbone | 1676 bp
  text	{zymo_cleanup}
  heading	Golden Gate assembly
  row	label | construct | fragments | enzyme
  row	Goc | gg | zGoa  +  zGob | BsaI
  text	{golden_gate_assembly}
  note	This gel is analytical: it makes no new sample and nothing is recovered from it. You take a few µL out of each tube and the tube goes on to the cleanup.

sheet 5	s5-transform	Transformation for Experiment golden
  ops	transform
  module	heat_shock_transformation
  values	heat_shock_transformation	{"antibiotics":"kan","host":"Mach1","plasmid":"gg","product_name":"pGOLD","temperature_C":37}
  source	gg			made			made by the goldengate step that produces gg
  columns	label | construct | DNA | strain | antibiotic | temperature
  sample	God | pGOLD | Goc | Mach1 | kan | 37
  text	{heat_shock_transformation}
  heading	Controls — three plates, the same for every kan transformation
  row	plate | what goes on it | it answers
  row	kan + | Mach1 + the kan control plasmid | the cells are competent and took up DNA
  row	kan − | Mach1, no DNA added | the plate is not simply growing untransformed cells
  row	kan streak | the kan control strain, streaked — not transformed | anything could have grown on this batch of kan plates
  text	Nothing here names the kan control stock. It is in the control stocks box; ask whoever keeps that box which tube it is.
  note	kan selection needs the resistance gene expressed before plating — outgrow in rich medium first.
  note	Streak the control strain onto a plate from the same batch as the others — it is that batch the plate is testing.
  note	A plate with no colonies has four possible causes — a badly poured plate, dead cells, a failed assembly, a failed transformation. The three control plates are how you tell them apart, so run them as carefully as the real one.

  ops	pick

  values	picking_colonies_into_block	{"antibiotic":"kan","colonies_per_sample":4,"samples":1}
  columns	label | clone | from plate
  sample	Goe | pGOLD_colonies | God
  text	{picking_colonies_into_block}
  heading	For this experiment
  row	 | 
  row	volume | 4mL
  note	4 clones, one tube each — under 5, so a block is more plasticware than it saves.
  note	STILL TO DECIDE: selection criteria — what counts as a colony worth picking here

sheet 7	s7-miniprep-sequencing	Miniprep and sequencing for Experiment golden
  ops	miniprep,sequencing
  module	qiagen_miniprep
  values	qiagen_miniprep	{"culture_mL":4}
  columns	label | from block | Box | Well
  sample	pGOLD-A | Goe | · | ·
  sample	pGOLD-B | Goe | · | ·
  sample	pGOLD-C | Goe | · | ·
  sample	pGOLD-D | Goe | · | ·
  text	{qiagen_miniprep}
  heading	Sequencing
  row	label | template | oligo
  row	pGOLD-A | pGOLD-A | 
  row	pGOLD-B | pGOLD-B | 
  row	pGOLD-C | pGOLD-C | 
  row	pGOLD-D | pGOLD-D | 
  note	Write the name on the cap AND on the side of the tube. A cap in a freezer box is read from above and a tube in your hand is read from the side, and a box of unlabelled sides is a box you have to open tube by tube.
  note	Write the well for every tube before it goes in the freezer. These rows are what the inventory is updated from when the workbook comes back.
  note	STILL TO DECIDE: which box and well each miniprep goes into — reserve the space before anybody is holding a tube
  note	STILL TO DECIDE: what these clones are clones of — nothing declared it, so they are named after the transformation’s product. Say `clone=<name>` on a Miniprep line in the characterization file to settle it.
  note	STILL TO DECIDE: which oligo to sequence with, and whether this is a region or the whole plasmid — c6-sim <cf> --primes <oligo> says where an oligo sits and whether it has more than one site

sheet 8	s8-analysis	Sequence analysis for Experiment golden
  ops	analysis
  columns	clone | reads | result | explanation
  sample	pGOLD-A | pGOLD-A | · | ·
  sample	pGOLD-B | pGOLD-B | · | ·
  sample	pGOLD-C | pGOLD-C | · | ·
  sample	pGOLD-D | pGOLD-D | · | ·
  heading	Result tokens — use one of these exactly
  row	token | what it means
  row	Perfect | Full region covered, matches the model.
  row	Perfect Partial | Matches where readable, but the region is not fully covered.
  row	Silent Mutation | Base change in the ORF, same amino acid.
  row	Missense Mutation | Base change in the ORF, the amino acid changes.
  row	Nonsense Mutation | Base change in the ORF, creates a stop codon.
  row	Indel | Insertion or deletion in the region — may frameshift.
  row	Mixed Clone | Two sequences in one trace; the colony was not clonal.
  row	Failed | Read unusable, or it will not align to the target.
  heading	The single clone you are most confident about
  row	clone | why
  row	 | 
  note	Align every read against the intended sequence of the construct, not against each other.
  note	The whole confirmation region may not be readable. Pay attention to the assembly junctions and to consistency with the model.
  note	Throw out any miniprep that is not Perfect or Perfect Partial. A tube nobody trusts that stays in the box is a tube somebody uses next year.
  note	Write down which clone passed. Every session after this one fetches that tube, and if the answer is not on this sheet it is in somebody’s memory.

sheet 9	s9-retransform	Electroporation for Experiment golden
  ops	retransform
  source	pGOLD			made			made by the transform step that produces pGOLD
  columns	label | construct | DNA | host | antibiotic | temperature | method
  sample	Gof | pGOLD_host | pGOLD | B.subtilis | Kan | 30 | electroporation
  heading	For this experiment
  row	 | 
  row	negative | untransformed
  row	positive | pCTRL
  note	3 plates: the sample, plus untransformed (negative) and pCTRL (positive). Every plate is electroporated the same way.
  note	No electroporation protocol is in the library yet, so this sheet carries the conditions and not the procedure. Nothing here tells you the cuvette gap, the voltage or the recovery medium.

sheet 10	s10-pick-culture	Picking and inoculation for Experiment golden
  ops	pick,culture
  module	picking_colonies_into_block
  values	picking_colonies_into_block	{"antibiotic":"Kan","colonies_per_sample":4,"samples":1}
  source	pGOLD_host			made			made by the retransform step that produces pGOLD_host
  source	B.subtilis/pGOLD-A			made			made by the pick step that produces B.subtilis/pGOLD-A
  source	B.subtilis/pGOLD-B			made			made by the pick step that produces B.subtilis/pGOLD-B
  source	B.subtilis/pGOLD-C			made			made by the pick step that produces B.subtilis/pGOLD-C
  source	B.subtilis/pGOLD-D			made			made by the pick step that produces B.subtilis/pGOLD-D
  columns	well | clone | from plate
  sample	A1 | B.subtilis/pGOLD-A | Gof
  sample	B1 | B.subtilis/pGOLD-B | Gof
  sample	C1 | B.subtilis/pGOLD-C | Gof
  sample	D1 | B.subtilis/pGOLD-D | Gof
  text	{picking_colonies_into_block}
  heading	For this experiment
  row	 | 
  row	lighting | blue+ambient
  heading	Culture
  row	label | construct | from | medium | vessel | volume
  row	Gog | pGOLD_cultures | A1, B1, C1, D1 | LB+Kan | 24-well | 4mL
  heading	For this experiment
  row	 | 
  row	temp | 30
  row	to | saturation
  row	inoculate | untransformed:LB
  note	4 clones in a 24-well block, filled down the columns: the axis a multichannel travels and the axis the block is read along.
  note	Photograph the plates under blue and ambient before picking. The photographs are the record of what you chose between.
  note	Control: inoculate untransformed into LB, well A2, from its restreak. It is not picked from — every colony on a control plate is the same thing.
  note	Grow to saturation. If a well has not grown, go back to picking or give the shaker more time — do not read a well that did not grow.
